moves.name: G-Max Toxitide
moves.needs: G-Max Toxitide: Floods the field with toxic water. Damages and poisons every opponent for 4 turns.

moves.name: G-Max Magma Drill
moves.needs: G-Max Magma Drill: A drill strike from a volcano. Lava flows onto the opponent's side and damages non-Rock-types for 4 turns.

moves.name: G-Max Overgrowth
moves.needs: G-Max Overgrowth: Vines erupt across the field. Sets Grassy Terrain and traps the opponents for 4 turns.

abilities.name: Thorn Ballad
abilities.description: Its sound-based moves get 1.2× power and have a 30% chance to poison the target.

abilities.name: Encore Amp
abilities.description: Each time it uses the same sound-based move on consecutive turns, that move's power rises by 20%, up to 1.6×. Switching out or using a different move resets the count.

abilities.name: Adaptive Plating
abilities.description: Changes form when its stats rise. A raise to Attack or Sp. Atk switches it to Attack Forme; a raise to Defense or Sp. Def switches it to Defence Forme. If one effect raises both, the bigger raise decides, and a tie keeps the current form. It returns to Standard Forme when it switches out or faints. This ability can't be copied, swapped or suppressed.

abilities.name: Plague Bulwark
abilities.description: When hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 50% chance to be poisoned. It takes 25% less damage from poisoned or badly poisoned attackers.

abilities.name: Soul Kindling
abilities.description: Its Psychic-type moves have a 20% chance to burn. Its Psychic-type moves deal 1.3× damage to burned targets.

abilities.name: Neon Circuit
abilities.description: Restores 1/16 of its max HP at the end of each turn. When an attacker makes contact with it, its rings flare and lower the attacker's accuracy by 1 stage.

abilities.name: Gem Orbit
abilities.description: It carries four orbiting gems. When it's hit by a super-effective move, a gem shatters and halves the damage. Works up to four times per battle.

abilities.name: Twin Maw
abilities.description: Its biting moves strike twice, once with each head. The second bite deals 25% of the first bite's damage.

abilities.name: Silent Cloak
abilities.description: The first move it uses after switching in gets +1 priority. If that move has a charge turn, the charge turn is skipped.

abilities.name: Dread Jaws
abilities.description: Its biting moves get 1.3× power and have a 30% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

descriptions.thornstrum: Sound-based. Hits all adjacent opponents and goes through Substitute. Power is 1.5× against a target that is poisoned or badly poisoned. Vine Riff's answer to Toxtricity's Overdrive.
descriptions.feedback-shred: Sound-based. Hits all adjacent opponents and goes through Substitute. 20% chance to paralyze each target.
descriptions.cataclysm-cannon: Fires molten iron from its back. Its power and effect depend on Cataggron's current form. Other Pokémon that learn it through Mimic or Sketch use the Standard version.
descriptions.grave-rampart: The user slams its sludge-soaked shield into the target. Damage is calculated with the user's Sp. Def instead of its Sp. Atk. 30% chance to poison the target.
descriptions.mindflare: It sets the target's mind alight. A special move that calculates damage against the target's Defense instead of its Sp. Def, like Psyshock. 10% chance to burn.
descriptions.neon-eclipse: It charges with its rings blazing, then cuts them dark at the moment of impact. The user restores HP equal to half the damage it deals.
descriptions.jewel-juggle: Hurls its gems one after another. Hits 2–5 times in a row. Each hit has a 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1 stage.
descriptions.prism-maw: Bites with crystal-studded jaws. A biting move that makes contact. 30% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
descriptions.dusk-volley: A two-turn move. On the first turn the user throws back its cloak and draws its bow. On the second turn it fires a volley of shadowed arrow quills. High critical-hit ratio. If it knocks out the target, the user's Speed rises by 1 stage. A Power Herb skips the charge turn.
descriptions.quake-jaw: Lunges up from the sand and clamps down. A biting move that makes contact. It can hit Flying-type Pokémon and Pokémon with Levitate; they take neutral damage from it.
descriptions.spark-splash: Splashes the target with charged water. 20% chance to paralyze the target.
descriptions.riptide-arc: Lashes the target with a current that arcs across the water. 30% chance to paralyze. Power is 1.5× in rain.
descriptions.imperial-plunge: Dives from high above with its wings folded. Makes contact. 30% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
descriptions.storm-rend: Slashes with charged wing claws. Makes contact and has a high critical-hit ratio. 10% chance to paralyze the target.
descriptions.burrow-snap: Snaps up from beneath the sand. A biting move that makes contact and traps the target for 4–5 turns, dealing 1/8 of its max HP at the end of each turn.
descriptions.wingsong: Vibrates its wings to make a droning hum. Sound-based, so it goes through Substitute. 20% chance to confuse the target.
descriptions.cyclone-wing: Slashes the air into a spinning cyclone. Power is 1.5× while Tailwind is active on the user's side.
descriptions.hypnospot: Flashes the eye patterns on its wings. 10% chance to make the target fall asleep. When Mega Alolan Flygon uses it, the chance rises to 30%.
descriptions.rune-jab: A quick punch charged with rune light. A punching move with +1 priority.
descriptions.bastion-fist: Swings its fist like a battering ram. A punching move that makes contact. It breaks the target's Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil before dealing damage.
descriptions.coral-splash: Sprays water full of sharp coral grit. 30% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
descriptions.pearl-pulse: Fires a beam of light from its pearls. A pulse move. 20% chance to raise the user's Sp. Def by 1 stage.
descriptions.reef-tempest: Calls up a storm from the reef. After it hits, rain starts and lasts 3 turns, or 5 turns if the user holds a Damp Rock.
descriptions.molten-sludge: Engulfs the target in a wave of burning tar. Makes contact. 30% chance to burn the target.
descriptions.carrion-dive: Dives on the target from high above. Makes contact and has a high critical-hit ratio.
descriptions.parcel-slam: Slams the target with a heavy crate. Makes contact. 30% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
descriptions.dumpster-slam: Rams the target with its whole metal body. Makes contact. 30% chance to poison the target.
descriptions.paella-pan-toss: Swings its huge paella pan over its head and flings sizzling rice at every opponent. Hits all adjacent opponents. 20% chance to burn each target.
descriptions.static-lash: Lashes out with a charged tongue. Makes contact and has +1 priority. 30% chance to paralyze the target.
descriptions.verdant-pulse: Sends out a pulse of magnetized spores. A pulse move. 30% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
descriptions.cable-snare: Wraps the target in live cables. Makes contact and traps the target for 4–5 turns, dealing 1/8 of its max HP each turn. 10% chance to paralyze.
descriptions.pitaya-burst: Bursts a ripe fruit over the battlefield. Hits all adjacent opponents, and the user restores 1/8 of its max HP.
descriptions.thunderhead-burst: Unleashes the storm cloud on its back. 30% chance to paralyze the target. Power is 1.5× on Electric Terrain.
descriptions.venom-gnash: Bites with venom-soaked fangs. A biting move that makes contact. 30% chance to badly poison the target.
descriptions.inferno-crush: Crushes the target under its blazing armor. Makes contact. 30% chance to burn the target.
descriptions.molten-coil: Wraps around the target with its red-hot body. Makes contact and traps the target for 4–5 turns, dealing 1/8 of its max HP each turn.
descriptions.froth-burst: Blasts the target with a churning burst of foam. 30% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1 stage.
descriptions.regal-ribbon: Lashes the target with shimmering ribbons. Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2 stages after use.
descriptions.ring-toss: Hurls its spinning hoop, which hypnotizes the target as it flies. 30% chance to make the target drowsy, so it falls asleep at the end of the next turn.
descriptions.drill-gale: Spins beak-first like a drill. Ignores the target's stat changes.
descriptions.fang-coil: Bites and coils around the target. Traps it for 4–5 turns, dealing 1/8 of its max HP each turn.
descriptions.tunnel-drill: Drills through the ground and the target. Ignores Protect.
descriptions.royal-decree: Raises the Defense and Sp. Def of the user's allies by 1 stage.
descriptions.venom-horn-charge: Charges horn-first. 30% chance to badly poison the target.
descriptions.ninefold-flame: Nine tongues of flame strike at once. Hits all opponents. 20% chance to burn each target.
descriptions.dream-ballad: Sings a drowsy ballad. Sound-based. 20% chance to make the target fall asleep.
descriptions.corpse-bloom: Releases a choking stench. Hits all opponents. 30% chance to poison each target.
descriptions.spore-grave: Buries the target in ghostly spores. The user restores HP equal to half the damage dealt.
descriptions.spore-cathedral: Raises a cathedral of ghostly mushrooms around the target. 30% chance to make the target fall asleep.
descriptions.eye-spot-flash: Flashes the eye patterns on its wings. 30% chance to confuse the target.
descriptions.panther-strike: Pounces from the shadows. High critical-hit ratio.
descriptions.mane-inferno: Charges wrapped in its burning mane. 20% chance to burn the target.
descriptions.solar-charge: A blazing charge. Its power isn't reduced in rain, and it thaws the user.
descriptions.whirlpool-punch: A punch wrapped in a spinning current. Punching move. Lowers the target's Speed by 1 stage.
descriptions.g-max-toxitide: Floods the field with toxic water. Damages and poisons every opponent for 4 turns.
descriptions.avalanche-roll: Rolls through the target like a landslide. 30% chance to make the target flinch.
descriptions.sunrise-gallop: A blazing charge at dawn's speed. Raises the user's Speed by 1 stage.
descriptions.corona-lance: Charges horn-first wreathed in sunfire. Sets harsh sunlight for 3 turns.
descriptions.leek-katana: Draws its katana-sharp leek in one swift cut. Slicing move. High critical-hit ratio.
descriptions.daish-strike: Strikes once with each blade. Slicing move. Hits twice. High critical-hit ratio.
descriptions.tusk-floe: Rams with its ice tusk. Sets snow for 3 turns.
descriptions.aurora-crash: Crashes down like a falling aurora. Sets Aurora Veil for 3 turns.
descriptions.abyss-lash: Lashes out with its long tongue. Pulls the target closer: the target can't switch out next turn.
descriptions.glacier-shard: Launches a jagged shard of glacier ice. High critical-hit ratio.
descriptions.night-terror: Haunts the target's dreams. Double power if the target is asleep.
descriptions.golden-pendulum: Swings a glowing pendulum. 30% chance to confuse the target.
descriptions.claw-haymaker: A huge swinging punch. Punching move. 30% chance to make the target flinch.
descriptions.iron-haymaker: A punch from armored gauntlets. Punching move. Breaks through Protect.
descriptions.abyss-pincer: Clamps with a scythe-like claw. High critical-hit ratio.
descriptions.abyssal-bite: Bites with its toothed claw. Biting move. 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
descriptions.ring-discharge: Fires a charged ring. Hits all opponents. 20% chance to paralyze each target.
descriptions.petrified-timber: Crushes the target with a stone-hard branch. 30% chance to lower the target's Speed.
descriptions.hollow-wail: Its three heads wail together. Sound-based. 30% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def.
descriptions.ossuary-crush: Swings a bone wreathed in ghost-fire. 20% chance to make the target flinch.
descriptions.soulfire-bone: Throws a bone burning with blue soulfire. 30% chance to burn the target.
descriptions.smokestack-blast: Belches flaming smog. 30% chance to poison or burn the target.
descriptions.g-max-magma-drill: A drill strike from a volcano. Lava flows onto the opponent's side and damages non-Rock-types for 4 turns.
descriptions.halo-blessing: Restores half of the max HP of the user and its allies and cures their status conditions.
descriptions.g-max-overgrowth: Vines erupt across the field. Sets Grassy Terrain and traps the opponents for 4 turns.
descriptions.coral-bloom: Coral bursts from the water around the target. The user restores 1/4 of its max HP.
descriptions.toxic-typhoon: A spiraling torrent of venom. 30% chance to badly poison the target.
descriptions.royal-maelstrom: Summons a whirlpool crowned with spray. Traps the target for 4–5 turns.
descriptions.antler-dive: Dives from the air antlers-first. High critical-hit ratio.
descriptions.jester-s-juggle: Throws glowing juggling balls. Hits 2 times. 20% chance to confuse the target.
descriptions.invisible-wall: Slams the target with a wall nobody can see. Lowers the target's Speed by 1 stage.
descriptions.crystal-bulwark: Raises a crystal shield. Sets Reflect and Light Screen for 3 turns.
descriptions.frozen-decree: Freezes the air with a royal command. 20% chance to freeze the target.
descriptions.stampede-charge: Charges like a whole herd. The user takes 1/4 of the damage dealt as recoil.
descriptions.fossil-scythe: Slashes with scythes of ancient stone. Slicing move. High critical-hit ratio.
descriptions.snowball-slam: Body-slams like a falling snowdrift. Sets snow for 3 turns.
descriptions.landslide-nap: Rolls over in its sleep like a landslide. Hits all adjacent Pokémon.
descriptions.aurora-wing: Sweeps a wing of frozen light. Hits all opponents. 20% chance to freeze each target.
descriptions.storm-crown: Calls down a crown of lightning. Never misses in rain. 30% chance to paralyze the target.
descriptions.phoenix-flare: Engulfs the target in sunfire. 30% chance to burn the target.
descriptions.psyblade-rush: Slashes with blades of psychic power. Slicing move. High critical-hit ratio.
descriptions.genesis-spiral: Spins a nebula around the target. Raises the user's highest stat by 1 stage.
descriptions.burrow-slam: Bursts up from underground. +1 priority on the first turn after it switches in.
descriptions.spiral-burrow: Burrows with its drill tail and strikes from below. Ignores Protect.
descriptions.four-star-barrage: Throws four starlit punches. Punching move. Hits 4 times.
descriptions.supernova-fist: A punch that bursts like a star. Punching move. Hits the target's weaker defense.
descriptions.lantern-snare: Lures the target with ghostly light and snares it in silk. The target can't switch out for 3 turns.
descriptions.wraith-brood: Releases ghostly spiderlings. Sets Sticky Web on the opponent's side.
descriptions.echo-screech: Fires rings of ultrasonic sound. Sound-based. Never misses.
descriptions.lure-overload: Overloads its lure with power. Hits all opponents. 20% chance to paralyze each target.
descriptions.muse-ribbon: Wraps the target in glowing ribbons. Raises the Sp. Atk of the user and its allies by 1 stage.
descriptions.celestial-verse: Recites a verse written in starlight. Raises the user's Sp. Def by 1 stage.
descriptions.prophet-s-gaze: Stares through time at the target. Can't miss, and ignores the target's stat changes.
descriptions.thousand-eyes: Every eye on its wings flashes at once. Lowers the target's evasion by 1 stage.
descriptions.blossom-waltz: Dances in a whirl of petals. Dance move. Raises the user's Sp. Atk by 1 stage.
descriptions.root-slam: Slams down with root-like arms. The user restores 1/4 of its max HP.
descriptions.kingdom-chorus: Croaks a royal anthem. Sound-based. Sets rain for 3 turns.
descriptions.pollen-gust: A gust full of glittering pollen. Hits all opponents. 10% chance to put each target to sleep.
descriptions.cotton-storm: A storm of cotton spores. Lowers the Speed of all opponents by 1 stage.
descriptions.solar-bloom: Blooms with the power of the sun. Fires instantly in harsh sunlight.
descriptions.noon-flare: Releases the full heat of noon. Sets harsh sunlight for 3 turns.
descriptions.wyrm-buzz: Buzzes its wings at dragon frequency. Sound-based. 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def.
descriptions.dragonstorm-wings: Whips up a storm with its wings. Hits all opponents.
descriptions.mire-chomp: Bites and drags the target into the swamp. Lowers the target's Speed by 1 stage.
descriptions.swamp-island: Rises from the swamp like an island and crashes down. Sets Grassy Terrain.
descriptions.omen-plume: Scatters feathers of ill omen. 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy.
descriptions.sigil-curse: Burns a cursed sigil into the target. It can't use the same move twice in a row for 3 turns.
descriptions.boss-s-order: Strikes, then orders the target away: forces it to switch out.
descriptions.lament: Sings a sorrowful lament. Sound-based. Lowers the target's Sp. Atk by 1 stage.
descriptions.requiem-aria: Sings a requiem. Sound-based. Hits all opponents.
descriptions.glyph-burst: Fires glowing letters at the target. Its type matches the user's most effective type against the target.
descriptions.rune-orbit: Glyphs spin around it and strike. Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage.
descriptions.rebound-blow: -4 priority. Deals 1.5× the damage of the last attack that hit the user this turn.
descriptions.fortress-cannon: Fires shells from its battlements. Sets Stealth Rock on the opponent's side.
descriptions.siege-barrage: Fires every cannon at once. Breaks screens.
descriptions.dune-sting: Strikes from under the sand with its stinger. 30% chance to poison the target.
descriptions.quicksand-sting: Drags the target into quicksand. It can't switch out for 3 turns.
descriptions.razor-glide: Glides through the target with bladed wings. Slicing move. High critical-hit ratio.
descriptions.scythe-wings: Slices with scythe-shaped wings. Slicing move. High critical-hit ratio.
descriptions.moonlit-fang: Bites from above. The user restores HP equal to half the damage dealt.
descriptions.marshal-bite: Bites with huge fangs. Biting move. Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage.
descriptions.glowing-fangs: Bites with glowing fangs. Biting move. Ignores the target's stat changes.
descriptions.spine-tsunami: Rams with a wave of spines. Sets Spikes on the opponent's side.
descriptions.crystal-breaker: Smashes with crystal spines. Removes the target's screens.
descriptions.moss-ferment: Drinks fermented berry juice. Restores half its max HP and raises its Defense and Sp. Def by 1 stage.
descriptions.hillside-press: Presses down with its mountainous shell. Uses the user's Defense instead of Attack. Power 100.
descriptions.phantom-frost: Slashes with frozen ghost claws. Slicing move. +1 priority if the target is at full HP.
descriptions.whiteout-slash: Slashes from inside a whiteout. Slicing move. Sets snow for 3 turns.
descriptions.caldera-burst: Its shell erupts. Hits all opponents and sets Stealth Rock.
descriptions.glacial-stampede: Stampedes like a glacier breaking loose. Hits all opponents.
descriptions.reef-mind: Its brain-coral core glows. Restores 1/4 of the max HP of the user and its allies.
descriptions.barrel-barrage: Fires shells from every barrel. Pulse move. Hits 2 times.
descriptions.broadside: Fires every cannon. Pulse move. Hits all opponents.
descriptions.phantom-ink: Sprays glowing ink. 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy.
descriptions.kraken-vortex: Drags the target into a dark whirlpool. Traps it for 4–5 turns.
descriptions.frozen-present: Throws a gift box of ice. 30% chance to freeze the target.
descriptions.diamond-dust: Releases a shower of diamond dust. Hits all opponents. Sets snow for 3 turns.
descriptions.gift-blaze: Throws a burning gift sack. 20% chance to burn the target.
descriptions.yule-bonfire: Dives wrapped in festive flames. Raises the user's Speed by 1 stage.
descriptions.sleigh-rush: Slides into the target on steel runners. Raises the user's Speed by 1 stage.
descriptions.avalanche-run: Rides down on the target like an avalanche. Can't miss in snow.
descriptions.triple-inferno: Each head breathes fire. Hits 3 times. Each hit has a 10% chance to burn.
descriptions.tread-crush: Rolls over the target on armored treads. Removes hazards from the user's side.
descriptions.spirit-antlers: Charges with ghost-flame antlers. 30% chance to confuse the target.
descriptions.phantom-crown: Its crystal antlers flare. Lowers the target's Sp. Def by 1 stage.
descriptions.painted-world: Paints the battlefield. Changes the terrain to match the type of the user's last-used move.
descriptions.rainbow-stroke: A sweeping stroke of every color. Its type changes to the type that's most effective against the target.
descriptions.cyclone-kick: Spins into a whirlwind of kicks. Removes hazards from the user's side.
descriptions.heartfelt-charge: Charges with its curled horns. The user and its allies restore 1/8 of their max HP.
descriptions.thunder-fang-strike: Strikes at lightning speed. +1 priority on the turn it switches in.
descriptions.eruption-charge: Charges like a volcano erupting. Power is higher the more HP the user has.
descriptions.aurora-spring: Sprays purifying water. Removes the target's stat boosts and cures the user's status.
descriptions.abyssal-aeroblast: Fires a vortex from the deep. High critical-hit ratio.
descriptions.rainbow-flare: Dives in rainbow flame. 50% chance to burn the target.
descriptions.season-s-turn: Turns the season. Its type and effect change with the user's form.
descriptions.cataclysm-cannon-defence: Fires molten iron from its back. Its power and effect depend on Cataggron's current form. Other Pokémon that learn it through Mimic or Sketch use the Standard version.
descriptions.cataclysm-cannon-attack: Fires molten iron from its back. Its power and effect depend on Cataggron's current form. Other Pokémon that learn it through Mimic or Sketch use the Standard version.
descriptions.hypnospot-mega: Flashes the eye patterns on its wings. 10% chance to make the target fall asleep. When Mega Alolan Flygon uses it, the chance rises to 30%.
